annotations.text:
THE Q'S BRIEF

The re-do turns the builder into a two-panel workbench. Left is what you want. Right is what the region already knows — and it is live: pick an AO and the rail fills with that AO's signature, formats, crowd-pleasers and the repeat ledger.

The ledger is steerable, not just informational. Tap a locked term to release it into the draft.

Everything is clickable. Pick an AO, set the brief, hit Generate.

PHONE IS THE REAL SURFACE

Qs build these at 21:00 the night before, on a phone. Intel collapses to a drawer, secondary controls hide behind one disclosure, and the action bar is opaque with a hard rule — not a translucent sticky bar.

The generation wait (~18s) becomes a muster log instead of a spinner: every line is a real stage of buildBeatdownContext.

PROOF IT IS LEARNING

This is the audit surface behind the rail. Knowledge version and freshness, per-AO archive coverage, the verbatim voice samples, and the exact backblasts that were read.

Flip the States tweak to 'stale' to see the honest failure case: past 14 days the knowledge row is dropped and generation goes blind. Today that happens silently.
